name: EWF Television Championship
epitaph: "The Star Spangled Kid" Johnny Banner won it from The Electric Youth at Ground-Zero (11 April 1995); by the fed's last recovered broadcast Dai Kaiju held it instead, an unrecorded transition, and Kaiju was still champion when a run-in stopped his defense against Hulk Hurley cold.

name: EWF Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: "Stingray" Steve Fontaine held it through the fed's own 20 April 1995 rankings bulletin; by the last recovered broadcast William the Conqueror held it instead, an unrecorded transition, and he retained it against The Electric Youth by count-out when the surviving record breaks off.

name: EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Madhouse Wrestling won it from Graveyard Shift at Ground-Zero (11 April 1995); Asylum held it by the fed's last recovered broadcast, an unrecorded transition, and lost it there to the debuting Beijing Beauties, still champions when the surviving record breaks off.
